meta.subject: BOB Hair Helsinki
meta.about_summary: BOB is more than a salon. It was born from the belief that a haircut can be a revolutionary act — just like the original bob cut of the 1920s challenged every social norm of its time. We are a space where hairdressing meets art, where clients come not just for a cut but for an experience. Our walls rotate local Helsinki artists. Our team collaborates with fashion designers and photographers. We believe beauty is culture, and culture shapes beauty. Vidal Sassoon said it best — if you don't look good, we don't look good. That philosophy drives everything we do.

creativeStrategy.designRationale: The Editorial Split layout is chosen to echo the fashion-magazine aesthetic, perfectly aligning with the 'art, design, and fashion' cultural hub philosophy. This allows for powerful visual storytelling with large, impactful imagery juxtaposed against concise, sophisticated typography. The Pinned Split Storytelling will be used for the founders' narrative to create an immersive and personal connection. Staggered line text reveals will add an editorial flair to service descriptions. The color palette balances a premium, dark feel with crisp whites and a warm, inviting accent that hints at creative warmth. Typography will be a key element in conveying sophistication and artistic sensibility.
